description: Computes the EIP-712 digest, domain separator, struct hash and encodeType from domain, types, primaryType and message (what wallets sign, including the x402 USDC TransferWithAuthorization). Every field is type-checked; a missing field fails with missing_field:<path> (not charged). Price: $0.01 USDC per call on Base mainnet ($0.001 on Base Sepolia), paid with x402; failed calls are not charged.

domain.description: EIP-712 domain: name, version, chainId, verifyingContract, salt.

primaryType.description: The primary struct type to hash.
